import sys

def main():
    tam_line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not tam_line:
        return
    tam = int(tam_line.strip())
    cad = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    arr = []
    cont = 0
    mayor = 0
    flg = False
    word = ""
    for i in range(tam):
        ch = cad[i]
        if ch == '(':
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0
            flg = True
            continue
        if ch == ')':
            flg = False
            if word != "":
                arr.append(word)
                word = ""
            continue
        if flg and ch != '_':
            word += ch
            continue
        if flg and ch == '_' and word != "":
            arr.append(word)
            word = ""
            continue
        if not flg and ch != '_':
            cont += 1
            if i == tam - 1 and cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            continue
        if not flg and ch == '_':
            if cont >= mayor:
                mayor = cont
            cont = 0
            continue
    print(f"{mayor} {len(arr)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
